subject: POC trial planning: workload intake & success criteria
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@fintechex.com>, Priya Gupta <pgupta@fintechex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC trial planning: workload intake & success criteria

Hi Sam / Priya,

Thanks again for the productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the trial: 

Summary / success criteria (as discussed)
- Business goal: validate Redwood inference for chat summarization and routing across peak trading hours for FinTechX.
- Success criteria (customer-confirmable):
  - End-to-end P95 latency (inference only) <= 300 ms for typical requests (120 tokens).
  - P99 latency < 1s for 95% of traffic.
  - Throughput sustain: baseline 5 RPS with ability to absorb bursts up to 80 RPS for 30-60s without request failures (errors < 1%).
  - Output quality: F1 / accuracy on baseline eval set to be within 2% of current model; no regressions on 3 critical prompts.
  - Operational: logs, tracing, and cost estimate delivered after 2 weeks of runs.

Workload intake items we need from you (please confirm / correct):
- Typical RPS: ~2 RPS (background), peak sustained: 25 RPS for short windows, burst RPS up to 80 for ~30-60s.
- Average token lengths: ~120 tokens/request; 99th percentile ~600 tokens.
- Concurrency: typical concurrent in-flight requests 4-6; ramp test should cover concurrency up to 40.
- Payloads: few hundred synthetic/example payloads + 20-50 real-sanitized examples for accuracy checks.
- Data sensitivity: contains masked PII; will need SOC2 controls and a private trial env if required.

Proposed POC timeline
- Week 0 (this week): ingestion of workload profile and share sample payloads + sign necessary MSA/NDA.
- Week 1: provision trial environment, warmup runs, smoke tests.
- Week 2: 48-72 hour sustained run at baseline traffic + 4 targeted burst tests.
- Week 3: quality evals, joint review, and recommendation.

Ownership
- Redwood: Ben Carter (sales / customer coord), Marissa Cole (SRE / env setup), Dylan Brooks (evaluation / metrics).
- FinTechX: Sam Patel (POC lead), Priya Gupta (security / compliance).

Next steps (please reply with confirmations + the items below so we can schedule kickoff):
1) Confirm the workload numbers above or provide corrected RPS/concurrency/token distributions.
2) Upload sample payloads (sanitized) and any eval prompts/labels.
3) Confirm whether you need a private VPC trial or if hosted trial is OK.
4) Provide a primary meeting time this week for a 30-min kickoff (we can do Thu/Fri).

Attachments: placeholder for sample payloads and MSA/DocuSign link (I will send after you confirm).

Thanks, happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the plan.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@fintechex.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Gupta <pgupta@fintechex.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 17:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC trial planning: workload intake & success criteria

Thanks Ben, this looks great and matches our notes. Quick confirmations and the data you requested below.

Confirmations / numbers
- Typical RPS: 2 (background).
- Sustained peak: 25 RPS for scheduled windows.
- Burst behavior: brief spikes up to ~80 RPS for 30-60s, usually on market open/close and when batch jobs run.
- Typical concurrency: 4-6; occasional concurrency spikes to 40 during stress events.
- Token sizes: median ~120, mean ~150, 99th ~600.
- Monthly volume: ~4M requests.

Security / environment
- We prefer a private trial VPC due to customer data flows. SOC2 evidence already requested, Priya will follow up with exact docs.

Attachments
- fintechex_sample_payloads.csv (sanitized examples)
- fintechex_poc_requirements.pdf (high-level POC ask)

Timeline
- Agree with the proposed timeline. Can we kickoff on Thu, Mar 25 at 10:00am PT? That gives our security team a day to confirm requirements.

Minor asks
- Can Redwood provide a short runbook for what you'll need us to run during the burst tests?

Thanks, Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Integrations
FinTechX

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC trial planning: workload intake & success criteria

Ben / Dylan, quick internal plan based on Sam's notes and attachments.

Runbook / setup notes
- I will provision a private trial VPC (per customer's ask) with a single-socket GPU worker pool and autoscaling knobs for burst handling.
- Need the sanitized payloads uploaded to the shared drive (Sam attached CSV, I'll pull).
- Test harness: we'll use our load generator to replay payloads with configurable RPS/concurrency. Will produce latency histograms, error rates, and token counters.

Experimental plan
- Day 1: warmup + smoke tests at 2 RPS, validate tracing/logging.
- Day 2: sustained run at 25 RPS for 24 hours with scheduled bursts (4x bursts to 80 RPS, 60s each).
- Day 3: targeted quality evaluation on the 50 labeled prompts provided.

Metrics and dashboards (Dylan lead)
- P95/P99 latency, throughput, error rate, cost per 1k tokens, and output quality deltas vs baseline.
- We'll drop links to a temporary dashboard and share after the first 24-hour run.

Owners
- Marissa: env provisioning, runbook, operational run.
- Dylan: evaluation harness, dashboards, quality metrics.
- Ben: customer coordination and sign-off.

Attachments: redwood_poc_runbook.md (run steps + what we will ask FinTechX to trigger).

I'll start provisioning once Sam confirms the kickoff time, I can have the env ready by Wednesday EOD for a Thu morning kickoff.

Thanks,
Marissa

Redwood Inference

3) Desired success criteria (finalized):

   - No regressions (>2% delta) on the 3 critical prompts you identified.
4) Deliverables/end of POC: run metrics + dashboard link, cost estimate, recommended config and next steps for production rollout.
